name: GTN Textiles Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1966, GTN Textiles Ltd manufactures and sells cotton yarn and is into realty business[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
GTL, part of the Kerala-based GTN Group, is primarily engaged in the production and sale of cotton yarn. It specializes in fine and superfine counts ranging from 30s to 120s, with a strong focus on 60s and above.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
